entries.set_purpose: One short set makes an upright trunk and relaxed opposite arm/leg rhythm visible before the running lesson. It deliberately repeats the useful basic preparation pattern with one focused observation; it does not add skipping or a technical height challenge.
entries.prior_current_next: Actual instructional-base/OR-01 rhythm or equivalent →one counted basic rehearsal →selected corridor lesson →OR-08/12 retain actual preparation level and cue needs.
entries.advance_hold_regress: Hold count, comfortable height and no-flight pattern. Record first fault; stop for symptoms or lost balance. A cleaner rhythm is useful without higher effort or an A-Skip upgrade.

standard_D.variant: Basic alternating march in place — explicit stationary teaching adaptation
standard_D.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2/10. Two seconds per comfortable walking-height step; four alternating steps, two each side, then settle2s. Use relaxed opposite arm/leg timing without a forced thigh-height target.
standard_D.notes: One foot remains supported; no flight or forward travel. Each left/right step is one count, not a two-step cycle. This is the same basic pattern used in the instructional preparation; it is not exact traveling A-March or sprint exposure.

entries.set_purpose: One short counted rehearsal makes the release, finish marker and gradual runout concrete before the full corridor walk. It is preparation, not an unrecorded full-route test or a maximal acceleration set.

entries.advance_hold_regress: Retain standing start and easy intent. Count the first scheduled attempt, including faults, then wait for E0; no additional practice while queues form.

standard_D.variant: Standing Static Short Start — low-intent teaching adaptation
standard_D.effort_load: Bodyweight; smooth easy intent rising from about2/10 toward3/10, then retain a relaxed comfortable rhythm. No maximal effort, measured speed quota or fly-zone result.
standard_D.notes: Each set is one whole counted attempt including any fault. Active/exit estimate15s; separate outside walking return20s. These are logistics estimates, not forced cadence. No corrective or assessment repetition is added. Exact steps/contacts and return metres remain actual observations.

entries.set_purpose: Each recovered easy-run set observes smooth buildup, comfortable upright rhythm and deliberate use of the finish/runoff. Standard D has two such attempts; compressed D has one. Standard L has one additional walking route observation; compressed L omits E1 after its counted E0 walk. No set seeks greater speed, longer distance or fatigue.
entries.prior_current_next: Actual OR-01 participation/short-start evidence plus E0 route observation and independent easy-jog ability →today’s actual easy run or named substitute →OR-08 same route with a separately justified intent decision →OR-12 retained route/output with supervised recovery responsibility.
entries.advance_hold_regress: Retain the chosen route, easy ceiling and familiar strength. Faults consume their opportunity and remain in workload; stop for symptoms or unsafe mechanics. OR-08 may consider only a justified gradual intent change after this route is repeatable; OR-12 later changes recognition of rest/return, not automatically speed or volume.
